allowlist.description: Treat every rule as an exception (default false).

trusted.description: Trust the list's code-running extended rules (default false). Audited.

ApiTokenInfo.description: Token metadata. The secret is never part of this type.

last_checked.description: RFC 3339: the last check, successful or not.

last_error.description:

not.

oneOf.description: The trusted root set (the signed `roots.json` of the same release).

skipped_lines.description: Lines skipped across the installed lists (invalid or too broad); not an error.

scope.description: Scope(s) the route required, comma separated; empty for public routes.

target.description: Path parameter identifying the target (e.g. a list or user id).

proxy_down.description: The explicit listener is down (a move failed and could not be undone); retry the change.

transparent_error.description: Why the transparent listener is down, when it is.

webui_down.description: The web API listener is down (same cause); this response came from an older listener.

webui_error.description: The web API could not use its configured port at startup (set with `webui_moved_to`).

Set when this update moved the web API: open it here. The old address keeps answering
for 30 seconds.

client.description: Id of the profile that blocked it (decimal).

list_id.description: List the rule came from, when known (domain-set hits).

source_host.description: Host of the initiating page, when known.

oneOf.description: The last build failed; the previous engine keeps serving.

building.description: A rebuild is queued or running.

built_at.description: When the installed engine was compiled (RFC 3339).

compile_ms.description: Compile time of the installed engine.

domain_set.description: Pure domain rules in the compact domain set.

oneOf.description: What the extended-rule index did with them (absent before the first build).

default_mode.description: The mode the category ships with.

loaded.description: Its list has been downloaded and verified (or loaded from the verified cache).

BypassCheckResponse.description: The effective answer for one host.

BypassEntryCounts.description: Entries per mode, for the current search text.

letters.description: First characters (`A`-`Z`, `#`) present among the rows matching the current filters.

source.description: `custom`, or `migrated` for entries made from the old `tls_passthrough_hosts` setting.

items.description: Matching domains (a bare domain covers its subdomains too; `*.x` only subdomains).

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page (absent on the last page).

last_error.description: A real failure of the last fetch (network, signature, parse). Skipped lines are not.

fp.description: SHA-256 of the DER, lowercase hex.

chain.description: The chain as presented, leaf first.

ev.description: The leaf carries an Extended Validation policy.

fp.description: SHA-256 of the leaf DER, lowercase hex.

sans.description: DNS names and IP addresses of the subjectAltName extension.

allow_connect_all.description: Approve `@connect *` (rejected if the script does not declare it).

ips.description: Addresses or CIDR prefixes identifying the device.

token_hint.description: Last 4 characters of the current token, to tell tokens apart.

servers.description: `ip` or `ip:port`; empty uses the system resolver.

building.description: A rebuild is queued or running.

scriptlet_resources_dropped.description: Resources of the loaded library that failed validation and are not served, with why.

ExplainResponse.description: What the policy does to one page URL.

csp_header.description: The extra `Content-Security-Policy` header value (proxy nonce shown as `PROXY_NONCE`).

effective.description: The base profile in effect before source rules.

enabled.description: False when the master switch is off.

network_enforce.description: Capabilities the proxy can block early for this page.

notes.description: Denials CSP cannot express for this page.

site.description: Registrable domain (or the host itself when it has none).

ExtIssueDto.description: A handed-off rule that could not be used.

dropped_untrusted.description: Dropped because the source list is not trusted.

ExtRuleResponse.description: A handed-off rule and what the extended-rule index did with it.

index.description: Position in the engine's handed-off rule list (stable within one build).

reason.description: Why the rule is unsupported / invalid.

state.description:
`active`, `dropped_untrusted`, `unsupported`, `invalid`, `badfiltered`, `badfilter`, or

ExtStatsDto.description: Outcome of building the extended-rule index.

dropped_untrusted_by_list.description: Rules dropped for lack of trust, per list id.

FailsafeDto.description: Whether decryption is held back because the first-party lists have not loaded yet.

active.description: HTTPS is tunnelled, not decrypted (hostname/SNI blocking still applies).

FaultStats.description:
Upstream and destination failures since start (individual events are only logged at debug
level; the log carries one summary per interval).

destination_refusals.description: Connections refused by the destination policy.

FilterListCounts.description: Filter lists per status, for the current search text.

letters.description: First characters (`A`-`Z`, `#`) present among the rows matching the current filters.

allowlist.description: Every rule of the list is treated as an exception.

attention.description:
Needs a look: the last fetch failed, or an enabled list was never fetched or is more

duplicate_count.description:
Rules of this list dropped as duplicates of an earlier list (or of itself) at the last
build; `rule_count + duplicate_count` is the list's total.

format.description: Format override (`auto` detects from the content; see the supported-formats table).

last_error.description: Error from the most recent fetch attempt, if it failed (cached content is still used).

trusted.description:
Trusted lists may use the code-running extended rules (`$replace`, `$urltransform`,
`#%#` scripts, snippets, unknown scriptlets); untrusted lists have those dropped.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; `null` on the last page.

page.description: Echoed only when the deprecated `page` parameter was used.

total.description: Lists matching `q` and `status`, across all pages.

pending_approval.description: Imported disabled / without approvals; enable it from the script's page.

ListMetaDto.description: Header metadata (`! Title:`, `! Expires:` ...) found in a list.

clients.description: Distinct client addresses seen in the last 5 minutes.

requests_per_sec.description: Requests served per second over the last few seconds.

PanelSettingsDto.description:
How the panel's confirmation page authenticates a change: `pin` (default), `session` (the panel
only links to the dashboard) or `none` (a click is enough; trusted LAN only).

enabled.description: Offer the in-page panel on pages of this profile (off by default).

pin_set.description: Whether a PIN is set (the PIN itself is never returned).

reserved_host.description: The deployment switch `script_control.panel_enabled` is separate; this is per profile.

PanelSettingsInput.description: Change panel settings. Omitted fields keep their value.

pin.description: Set a new PIN (4 to 64 characters).

sri_verified.description: An `@require` integrity hash was present and verified.

PlanUpdateDto.description: What confirming the plan of an already installed script would change.

needs_reapproval.description: The change widens what the script can match, reach or run; confirming approves it.

PlanUserscriptRequest.description: Start an install: exactly one of `source` or `url`.

PolicyExportDto.description: Portable policy document (temporary grants are not exported).

PolicyProfileDto.description:
Capabilities a preset allows. Page-level ones apply to the document; the two source lists
apply to first-party (same registrable domain) and third-party sources.

dropped.description: Distinct items discarded by the per-page bound.

enabled.description: Master switch; nothing is enforced while false.

global.description: Preset for sites without a rule.

network_hints.description: Let the proxy block denied third-party subresources early.

strip_blocked_scripts.description: Remove blocked `<script>` elements from HTML (saves the download).

strip_meta_refresh.description: Remove `<meta http-equiv="refresh">` from pages whose scripts are blocked.

generation.description: Bumped on every policy change (and when a temporary grant expires).

PreviewRequest.description: A proposed change, evaluated without saving.

remove_ids.description: Ids of site rules, source rules or temporary grants to drop.

ProfileDto.description: A profile (response). `id` is the decimal profile id; `"0"` is the default profile.

last_error.description:

absent when the last build succeeded or the proxy reports no build status.

allowed_clients.description: CIDRs of clients allowed to use the proxy.

allowed_destinations.description: CIDR exceptions to the destination refusals.

oneOf.description: Where the listeners are actually bound right now (absent without a running proxy).

bypass.description: Source of the signed first-party lists.

explicit.description: Effective switches of the explicit-proxy listener.

transparent.description: Effective switches of the transparent listener.

webui_host.description: Address the web API listens on.

bypassed_total.description: Requests and tunnels handled in `full` bypass since the proxy started.

explicit.description: Live counters of the explicit-proxy listener.

failsafe.description: Bypass fail-safe: HTTPS is tunnelled until the first-party lists have loaded.

ReportIssueDto.description: One problem found while building a list.

RequestLogEntry.description: One request in the live log.

status.description: Upstream status, when there was one.

signed.description: A signed set is active (otherwise the compiled-in set).

preview.description: First 200 characters of the JSON value.

subscribed.description: A subscription to this URL exists.

tls_error.description: HTTPS is configured for the web UI but not being served (the page is plain HTTP).

address.description: Bound address (`ip:port`) while enabled and running; else the configured one.

tls_passthrough_hosts.description: TLS hosts that are tunnelled instead of intercepted (exact or `*.suffix`).

note.description: An empty string clears the note.

`@run-at`, new or changed `@require`/`@resource`, changed required code.

are left unchanged.

restart_required.description: Fields saved to the config file that only apply after a restart.

need a restart.

strings (UUID / RFC 3339).

chose it and checked its install URL), not for the code.

needs_gm.description: `none`, `basic` or `xhr`: which GM APIs it needs.

source.description: `signed`, or `unavailable` while none has verified yet (then `entries` is empty).

values.description: One page of values, sorted by name.

listener is serving TLS right now.

active.description: The listener is serving TLS now.

x-scopes.ca:read: Read CA certificate details (fingerprint, expiry, subject).
x-scopes.config:write: Change or reload the proxy configuration.
x-scopes.devices:read: List and view devices (profile, addresses, token state; never the token).
x-scopes.devices:write: Create, edit and delete devices; issue and revoke device tokens.
x-scopes.engine:reload: Trigger a rebuild of the blocking engine.
x-scopes.lists:read: View filter lists, their status and the update schedule.
x-scopes.lists:write: Add, edit, remove and refresh filter lists; change the update schedule.
x-scopes.logs:read: Read the request log, live and recent (full browsing history of every client the token may see).
x-scopes.policy:read: View script policy rules, explanations, temporary permissions and blocked-source reports.
x-scopes.policy:write: Change script policy settings, rules and temporary permissions; import policy.
x-scopes.profiles:read: List and view filtering profiles (lists and overlay rules) the token may access.
x-scopes.profiles:write: Create, edit and delete filtering profiles.
x-scopes.rules:read: Read custom rules; validate rules and test URLs against the engine (no changes).
x-scopes.scripts:write: Install, update, enable, disable and remove userscripts; view and clear their stored values.
x-scopes.sessions:admin: List and revoke any user's sessions.
x-scopes.sessions:self: Log out, change your password, list and revoke your own sessions.
x-scopes.stats:read: Read blocking, proxy and engine statistics.
x-scopes.system:read: Read system status and metrics (JSON and Prometheus).
x-scopes.tokens:admin: List and revoke any user's API tokens.
x-scopes.tokens:self: Create, list and revoke your own API tokens.
